_validation_note: 14-day window (May 20–June 3) and 21-day broadening window (May 13–June 3) both exhausted. Eight candidates evaluated across all four mechanism categories. No candidate passed all seven gates. Window was broadened to 21 days within the same mapper run; no additional candidates survived. The two most developed candidates (C1 GCI fiber, C8 LNG jurisdiction gap) came closest but failed Gate 3 and Gate 5 respectively. C8 in particular has a structurally sound mechanism but its claimed chokepoint resolves to a multi-member commission (FERC, RCA, or legislature) at every layer. The validator did not lower the bar to force a selection.

dropped_mechanisms.name: GCI AU-Aleutians Subsea Fiber Infrastructure System
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: missing_primary_source_per_layer — FCC cable landing license settlement URL (L2) returned HTTP 503 on two independent fetch attempts; Layer 3 (GCI unilateral repair authority) sourced only to news articles with no contract, org chart, or official document establishing the claimed dispatch authority; Layers 4 and 5 also lack primary sources beyond news articles. Removing L2 breaks the FCC regulatory layer of the chain. Gate 3 fails.

dropped_mechanisms.name: DAF Alaska Enhanced Use Lease Three-Base AI Data Center Program
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: no_news_tie — The ClearanceJobs article (April 14, 2026) and Air and Space Forces Magazine article (April 11, 2026) are both outside the 14-day window. No in-window (May 20–June 3) published news article about the May 29 Alaska-specific EUL proposal deadline or submissions was found on Breaking Defense, Federal News Network, Data Center Dynamics, or ADN. The deadline event is in-window but an event alone without a published news article covering it does not satisfy Gate 1.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Alaska BEAD Subgrantee Grant Execution Stack (GCI-Quintillion Novation Gate)
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: no_news_tie — ADN April 22, 2026 trigger is 42 days before the run date, outside the 21-day broadening window. The GCI Aleutians fiber break articles are in-window but address cable repair, not BEAD subgrantee novation mechanics.

dropped_mechanisms.name: AIDEA Section 1002 Area Capital Deployment Gate
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: no_ak_consequence — The AI connection claimed is that seismic data from Arctic refuge oil exploration will inform future North Slope AI infrastructure siting decisions. This is too attenuated to satisfy Gate 4's requirement for a concrete Alaska AI consequence reducible to sector + decision/risk + named actor + timeframe. The mechanism itself concerns Arctic oil exploration capital deployment. 21-day broadening window applied; still fails Gate 4.

dropped_mechanisms.name: APFC FY27 Investment Policy Statement Adoption Gate
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: no_ak_consequence and diffuse_chokepoint — Gate 4 fails: no concrete Alaska AI industry consequence can be named; a 1% reduction in a globally diversified $86B fund's PE allocation does not trace to a specific Alaska AI sector decision or named actor. Gate 5 also fails: the IPS adoption requires a board vote, making it a committee decision not a single-officer binary.

dropped_mechanisms.name: SBA Tribal 8(a) New-Entrant Application Freeze — ONAA Vacancy Gate
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: recent_repeat — The May 25 post already anatomized 'ANC 8(a) Sole-Source Federal Contracting Pipeline — SBA Application Gate and Corporate Subsidiary Stack.' The underlying mechanism (SBA 8(a) program, application processing gate, ANC participation) substantially overlaps the prior anatomy's layer chain. Gate 7 fails.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Alaska Railbelt OATT — RCA Docket U-25-028
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: no_news_tie — The RCA What's New page (fetched June 3, 2026) contains no entries for docket U-25-028 or OATT in May or June 2026. The ADN May 28 Fairbanks rate article does not mention U-25-028. No in-window published article naming U-25-028 was found. Gate 1 fails.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Alaska LNG Import Gas Supply Contract Jurisdiction Gap — FERC CP26-61-000 / AS 42.05.711(v)
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: diffuse_chokepoint and missing_primary_source_per_layer — Gate 5 fails: every candidate chokepoint resolves to a multi-member body (FERC multi-member federal commission, RCA five-commissioner panel, or Alaska Legislature). No single named officer holds an asymmetric binary over the mechanism's critical gate. Gate 3 partial failure: the Federal Register notice CP26-61-000 (L1 primary source) is CAPTCHA-blocked and its verbatim span could not be confirmed. Note: 15 U.S.C. § 717b(e)(1) was confirmed for FERC exclusive siting authority; SB 180 text and bill status on akleg.gov were confirmed for AS 42.05.711(v) and its legislative failure. The mechanism is structurally real but fails the asymmetric chokepoint gate.
